description.value:
Deadly Sentencing — Innate Technique (3rd level)

Domain Expansion (rules): full-turn action, 20 CE unless stated, 175-ft radius, 1 minute. When the domain ends you suffer Technique Burnout (applied automatically by the module).

Beginning at 3rd level, your will lets you expand your domain for free once per long rest. Within the domain, no offensive action can be taken by either party. The target must make a contested Persuasion check against you to prove their innocence. You gain a piece of Evidence determined by a d20 roll. If you succeed, they suffer the punishment based on your Evidence for 1 minute and the domain ends.

Roll Evidence
1 Innocent: The person is innocent but accused of a heinous crime which is easily excusable. You fail unless the defendant admits to it for some reason, if so a dependent punishment can apply.
2-9 Guilty: The person is guilty of a small crime with minimum evidence, your roll is normal. Confiscation
10-15 Very Guilty: The person is guilty of a crime, and you have good evidence, your roll is at advantage. Confiscation
15-19 Severely Guilty: The person is guilty of a severe crime, and you have decent evidence. Death Penalty
20 Unforgivably Guilty: The person is guilty beyond a doubt of an unforgivable sin, you instantly succeed. Death Penalty, Confiscation

Confiscation: The target loses either their innate technique or any magic items(items first). A creature without loses their CE.
Death Penalty: Your Judge’s Gavel is replaced by the Executioner’s Sword which instantly kills the accused on a hit.
Your DM may impose bonuses or penalties to Evidence rolls if fitting.
Your domain is Non-Lethal and instead of a guaranteed hit, gains the benefits of Peace Treaty as listed in Non-Lethal Domains. If you manage to convict a target with Confiscation or Death Penalty, you are not affected by Technique Burnout when your domain ends.
